technical.summary: CVS shows solid directional alignment with price above all major moving averages and sustained bullish RSI momentum, but lacks confluence from volume-based confirmers (OBV, CMF) and is compressed within technical compression zones (Bollinger Squeeze), suggesting caution for swing entry initiation.

fundamental.summary: No detectable insider or institutional signals with earnings 16 days out presents neutral positioning with moderate forward earnings risk.

sentiment.summary: Fear-driven market sentiment presents contrarian buying opportunity; AAII neutral and COT commercial positioning offer no headwind, but lack of congressional signals limits confirmation strength.

risk.summary: FOMC decision in 2 days with elevated VIX (29.9) creates significant event risk; new swing entry inadvisable until post-announcement clarity.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with sustained bullish RSI across all periods and supertrend confirmation provides solid directional alignment in a fear-driven market presenting contrarian opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: FOMC decision in 2 days with elevated VIX (29.9) creates unacceptable event risk that outweighs technical alignment, compounded by volume confirmers (OBV, CMF) failing to validate price strength and Bollinger Squeeze limiting volatility expansion.

decision.entry_rationale: FOMC event risk in 2 days with elevated VIX (29.9) blocks swing entry despite moderate technical alignment; wait for post-announcement clarity.
decision.primary_risk: Macro event volatility from FOMC decision creates unacceptable slippage risk that overrides technical setup; volume confirmers (OBV, CMF) fail to validate strength.
